afferent_arteriole.name: Afferent Arteriole
afferent_arteriole.description: Branch of the renal interlobular artery with a wide lumen bringing high-pressure oxygenated blood into the glomerulus.

glomerulus.name: Glomerulus (Capillary Knot)
glomerulus.description: High hydrostatic pressure capillary bed where blood plasma is forced through podocyte filtration slits during non-selective ultrafiltration.

efferent_arteriole.name: Efferent Arteriole
efferent_arteriole.description: Arteriole leading away from glomerulus with a narrower lumen than afferent arteriole, maintaining essential high filtration pressure.

bowmans_capsule.name: Bowman's Capsule (Glomerular Capsule)
bowmans_capsule.description: Double-walled cup lined with specialized podocyte cells collecting the glomerular filtrate (water, glucose, urea, ions, amino acids).

proximal_convoluted_tubule.name: Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT)
proximal_convoluted_tubule.description: Lined with microvillar brush border and rich in mitochondria for active tubular reabsorption of 100% of glucose and amino acids, and ~70% of Na+ and water.

loop_of_henle.name: Loop of Henle (Hairpin Loop)
loop_of_henle.description: Extends deep into renal medulla establishing a hypertonic medullary osmotic gradient via the countercurrent multiplier mechanism.

distal_convoluted_tubule.name: Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT)
distal_convoluted_tubule.description: Site of selective tubular reabsorption and active tubular secretion (H+, K+, creatinine); aldosterone regulates Na+ reabsorption.

collecting_duct.name: Collecting Duct
collecting_duct.description: Channels urine towards renal pelvis; ADH (anti-diuretic hormone) regulates water permeability via aquaporins to concentrate urine during osmoregulation.
